title: Within-person networks of clinical features of social anxiety disorder during cognitive and interpersonal therapy
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-person network
limitations: - Limited number of repeated observations per patient (M = 19.6, range = 18–21) which may lead to biased estimates; - No correction for multiple testing; - Centrality measures developed for social networks may not fully capture psychological network dynamics; - Time lag of half-week may not capture fast effects of SAD processes; - Sample may not be generalizable due to higher symptom severity and unemployment rates.
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. The code and data are declared available in the supplementary materials, but specific links or repositories are not provided in the text. The authors state that the R code is available in the supplemental material, but no direct link is given in the main text.
